construction_era.definition: date_report within 730 days (inclusive) of that wellbore's own first_ddr
construction_era.allocation_method: proportional, largest-remainder rounding to guarantee sum=50

production_era.definition: date_report more than 730 days after that wellbore's own first_ddr
production_era.allocation_method: proportional, largest-remainder rounding to guarantee sum=50

seed_note: Python random.seed(42); random.sample() used per stratum. Seed 42 chosen for consistency with the RAND(42) seed already used in this rebuild's prior spot-checks (Stage 4 classifier verification).
